notes.title: Summer Update
notes.content:
[h2]New Class[/h2][h3] [/h3][p][/p][h3]Beach Boy:[/h3][p][/p][p]The Beach Boy class introduces a new way to control the battlefield with summer-themed abilities and a water gun as its weapon. Beach Boy can set up sprinklers that spray water in all directions, damaging nearby enemies, and use a surfboard to block incoming attacks before sending it forward to strike opponents. Its ultimate ability covers the map with waves of sprinklers and surfboards, damaging all enemies caught in their path.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139239/0a33b49e42bf72adfd1be7769f65e15dd00d591f.png"][/img][/p][h2]New Items[/h2][p][/p][p]This update also introduces several summer-themed items:[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139239/d16875de5bb21faa7b92aad59dc412c6b1ec6077.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139239/36f553d146999452eea73aab42a1c4a1391abad5.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139239/4f480c9cd99332970f1a2a8f6a97b660b9892748.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139239/a334be8f5c47e28747dd19b1de3a2606fe7d5ee9.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Volleyball Net (Legendary Active)[/h3][p][/p][list][*][p]Set up a volleyball net across the center of the map, damaging every enemy that collides with it. (30s cooldown)[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Volleyball (Epic Active)[/h3][p][/p][list][*][p]A volleyball orbits around the player, striking and damaging any enemies it touches. (30s cooldown)[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Sun (Rare Passive)[/h3][p][/p][list][*][p]The sun sharpens your focus, granting 5% precision, while its warmth fills you with 5% speed.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Sun Cream (Uncommon Consumable)[/h3][p][/p][list][*][p]Apply sun cream to gain 1 vulnerability point and boost your speed by 10% for 5 seconds.
[/p][/*][/list][h2]New Map[/h2][p][/p][p]A new Summer Map is now available, offering a fresh environment to try out the new class and items.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139239/13da65cdfc29dd9a9db3b69fa69a3f6c42b3facf.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Final Notes[/h2][p][/p][p]For this update, the game will be on sale at 85% off,  so if you're interested, give it a try! In addition to that, the Beach Boy class and the two actives will be playable in the demo. As always, feel free to reach out on the Steam Discussion Board or Discord with any questions, suggestions, or bug reports. I hope this update adds some summer feeling to the game.[/p]

notes.title: Elements Update
notes.content:
[h2]New Class[/h2]

[h3][*] Frostburn:[/h3]
[list]
[*] The Forstburn class specializes in using elemental powers. Forstburn can switch between two orbs orbiting the player: an ice orb and a fire orb. Switching orbs grants a temporary 5-second buff and leaves behind either a fire node that deals damage or an ice pool that slows enemies. The ultimate ability transforms the entire map into either fire or ice, depending on which orb is currently equipped.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139239/14510c4013187251d04420d7adde95278cf5e4e0.png[/img]
[/list]

[h2]New Items[/h2]
This update includes 7 new elements which will act as a passive: 

[list]
[*]  [h3][*]Legendary Items:[/h3]

[olist]
[*] Air - Each time you gain speed, permanently increase your speed by 2%.
[*] Death - Gain 1 permanent damage for every 1000 points earned, up to a maximum of 3.
[*] Earth - Each time you prevent damage, permanently gain 0.2% luck.
[*] Light - Each time you land a precision hit, permanently gain 0.2% precision.
[/olist]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139239/df75bbbf290be38be4864dc962dbbcf08c0b0ed5.png[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139239/3bc657da1af7c69f934cc3c567be93e184ea4b4c.png[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139239/668da1f1a0ec70c63e1ec205a0a595df9ed31447.png[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139239/825bda2db44d257bbe7b96efa9ec37311aaf8136.png[/img] 
[*]  [h3][*]Epic Items:[/h3]

[olist]
[*] Fire - 5% chance to create a fire node when killing an enemy.
[*] Water - 5% chance to create a water pool when killing an enemy.
[*] Lightning - Strikes a random enemy every 10 seconds.
[/olist]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139239/b39d0ba09f620da62b62fd8c9ae180f9e9bc22c1.png[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139239/e10b30597de83739fb000006a428f26ac607069c.png[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139239/dfd13d59f4cba6e73ff511a544bec11e21e710c0.png[/img] 
[/list]

[h2]Final Notes[/h2]

For this update, the game will be on sale at 60% off, starting at 19 CET ( 10 PST) so if you're interested, give it a try! As always, feel free to reach out on the Steam Discussion Board or Discord with any questions, suggestions, or bug reports. I hope this update adds an exciting new passive ability that's fun to play with!

notes.title: High Score Devlog 6
notes.content:
As promised, here is a more detailed rundown of the Christmas update coming this Wednesday. This update will introduce two new classes: Santa and Elf along with six more items to unlock.

[h2]New Classes[/h2]

[olist]
[h3][*] Santa:[/h3]
[list]
[*] The Santa class is focused on boosting stats, achieving 100% luck and precision. Santa will use present bombs to unveil temporary stat boosts, and its ultimate ability grants 100% luck and precision while in an area.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139239/a189b237bac45129620f697ac1e8eeba1bbde472.png[/img]
[/list]
[h3][*] Elf:[/h3]
[list]
[*] The Elf class revolves around crafting upgrades with scrap. It uses a little toy car that leaves behind pieces of scrap. These scraps can be used to make your weapon faster and even upgrade it to a shotgun with 30 scraps. The Elf's ultimate ability allows you to hop into the toy car, which will shoot after 30 scraps and become faster after 20.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139239/ef7074acf5fbb2f54142a3b37cbdd3da494e8edf.png[/img]
[/list]
[/olist]

[h2]New Items[/h2]
This update includes six new items: two active, two consumable, and two passive items:

[list]
[*]  Active Items:
[olist]
[*] Snow Storm (Legendary) - Summons a snowstorm from the top of the map, damaging enemies as it falls.
[*] Reindeer Pack (Epic) - Sends a pack of reindeer running left to right, damaging enemies in their path.
[/olist]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139239/92dcd1b190fa08ee03700c4f6bac0f29dd286925.png[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139239/fc27a751b0c840b4bb80a493e8025fff03cc6b0f.png[/img]
[*]  Consumable Items:
[olist]
[*] Hot Choco (Legendary) - Grants 100% luck and precision for a limited time after drinking.
[*] Candle (Rare) - Lures enemies and explodes when it burns out.
[/olist]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139239/12c7de197be756ea41b337404baf6960720dad7a.png[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139239/376c6c50a1967563ff61f54e8b0a99ff93b71d5a.png[/img]
[*] Passive Items which introduces a new effect mechanic which will occur on first hit:
[olist]
[*] Mistletoe (Epic) - The first hit after cooldown will act as a kiss instead of a hit, granting 100% luck for some time.
[*] Skates (Rare) - Provides a temporary speed boost when hit.
[/olist]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139239/4c1faf8ec7e5b1056682b58a73e80f38d4d7335d.png[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139239/84b49e98ba58a7c65d01dd9ef23fbdf974250632.png[/img]
[/list]

I almost forgot to mention that this update also brings in the first map skin which can be changed in the Video Settings. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139239/7c2ea5a22996e42fc9117aece8f5db168d2438f5.png[/img]

[h2]Final Notes[/h2]

As always, feel free to reach out on the Steam Discussion Board or Discord for any questions, suggestions, or bug reports. I hope this update sparks more interest! I’ll continue updating the game and aim to bring in another update like this in the future. I'll also address any issues that arise, including balancing changes if any classes feel too weak or too powerful.

notes.title: High Score Devlog 2
notes.content:
I'm excited to share that I'm in the final stages of preparing the demo for release on Steam. It should be available for you to play within the next month! This demo will not only give you a taste of the game but will also serve as an opportunity for playtesting, allowing me to identify and fix any potential bugs before the full game launches. If you're interested in getting involved earlier, feel free to join our Discord server, where you can participate for a potential alpha build of the full game.

In this devlog, I want to spotlight the item system that's already implemented in the game. When the main game launches, it will feature at least 60 items, all of which can be unlocked using tickets earned in the store or through the grab machine. These items fall into three categories: active, passive, and consumable.
[list]
[*][b]Active Items[/b]: These are powerful tools with cooldowns. They can range from significant stat boosts for a limited time to objects that assist you in battle. You can equip up to 3 active items at a time.
[*][b]Consumable Items[/b]: These items are also powerful but recharge after every round, meaning they don’t have a traditional cooldown. You can use them once per round, and in endless mode, they reset every 2 minutes, with a maximum of 3 uses at a time. This means you can carry up to 3 consumables.
[*][b]Passive Items[/b]: Passives provide ongoing stat boosts or other effects. For example, the "Pouch" item grants an extra consumable charge each round. You can equip up to 6 passive items, and I plan to expand the variety with more interesting effects. For instance, I'm considering adding a passive that temporarily increases your speed when you take damage.
[/list]
[b]All passive items that boost speed  (5%, 8%, 12%, 15%)[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139239/8fdd379096f8595979c534781ebd1e1ecad65e08.png[/img]

[b]All passive items that boost luck  (5%, 8%, 12%, 15%)[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139239/89cb0973c8b04a5afdbf92645a2a68ae0f68a8bc.png[/img]

[b]All passive items that boos precision (5%, 8%, 12%, 15%)[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139239/50540d54ae24c33a995203b37f1b41115f80ddcc.png[/img]

Items will come in various rarities, ranging from Uncommon and Rare to Epic and Legendary, with each tier offering increasingly powerful effects. Some items share similar themes and can be grouped into their own subcategories. One of my personal favorites is the collection of "Jars." These consumables each contain a different bug inside.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139239/f8b8724ce6896e6d5317cc9d7ccc3730cd3b9e18.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139239/69a0a9a5aad30a5ca1924ca680b87f1c24a793a0.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139239/2a276dfa64025b7d181544bad6b438215b7d256e.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139239/92776acc61848a488e6291e5538b5eb384cfd559.png[/img]

I hope this gives you a clear understanding of the item system in the game. It's designed to be simple yet flexible, allowing for easy expansion in future updates—a plan I definitely intend to pursue. In addition to adding more items, I'm also working on expanding the roster of classes. I'll dive deeper into that in the next devlog.

I hope you'll give the demo a try when it comes out and share your feedback with me. Your input is invaluable as I continue to refine and improve the game.

notes.title: High Score Devlog 1
notes.content:
I plan to occasionally post devlogs highlighting game features and updates. Initially, these devlogs will focus on showcasing existing features. After the game’s release, they will shift to covering new features, bug fixes, and balance changes.

First, let me introduce the game. It’s a classic top-down action shooter where you battle waves of numerical enemies. Unlike traditional action shooters, where you lose health until it reaches zero, in this game, getting hit lowers your score and increases your vulnerability (more on this later). The goal is not to survive but to minimize damage and achieve the highest score possible. In Endless Mode, the mechanics change slightly—you must survive waves until your vulnerability reaches its maximum level.
During each run, you can earn tickets, which can be spent on powerful items or to unlock new classes. Currently, there are eight different classes, each with two unique abilities and one ultimate. Some classes also have a unique passive ability. In each run, you can equip up to three active items, three consumables, and six passives to help you achieve even higher scores. At present, there are around 60 different items in the game, with plans to expand and add more items and classes post-launch.

Since this is the first devlog, I’ll use it to explain the five different statistics in the game, as they are core mechanics that can be enhanced through various items:
[list]
[*]Damage: The damage dealt by your main weapon.
[*]Precision: The chance to double your main weapon’s damage. This can be permanently increased to a maximum of 0.8 and can only reach 1 with temporary effects. When your Precision reaches 1, a rainbow border will appear around your character.
[*]Luck: The chance to avoid taking damage and instead gain the same amount as a bonus. Like Precision, Luck can be permanently increased to 0.8 and can only reach 1 with temporary effects. A rainbow effect will indicate when your Luck is at 1.
[*]Speed: The current movement speed of your character.
[*]Vulnerability: The damage multiplier when hit by an enemy. This multiplier increases by 1 after a certain number of hits, capping at a maximum of 5. Every 15 seconds, you regenerate one point of Vulnerability.
[/list]
The game’s UI highlights all your active items, consumables, and passives in the top corners of the screen. At the top center, your current Vulnerability level is displayed, which can go up to a maximum of 5. In this run, the player is using a shield passive that increases the available Vulnerability points; without this passive, the cap is 3. In the bottom left corner, a small table displays your current statistics. Any temporary stat boosts are shown in green. If this table feels cluttered, you can hide it in the settings. The bottom right corner displays your score and time, while your abilities and their cooldowns are shown at the bottom center.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139239/ff87fa3148279cefd6d27c2e0c2e50c0fe3da961.png[/img]
The last, somewhat hidden, statistic in the game is ticket gain. By default, each hit gives you a 0.08% chance of earning a ticket. This can be increased through items, allowing you to gain tickets more effectively. Ticket gain isn’t limited to just this chance—during each normal run, you can spin a wheel to win tickets, with the number of spins determined by the medal you earn. Additionally, there are unique items, like the Present and the Golden Dagger, that provide a small boost to your ticket gain.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139239/14c5e4f1355c069b80ebff012cfe082f439bea8a.jpg[/img]

I hope this first devlog gives you some insight into the game I’ve created and sparks your interest. If you’d like to stay updated, you can wishlist the game to be notified when it’s released or join the [url=https://discord.gg/jfQnaHHpqn]Discord[/url] if you have any questions. I’m also planning to release a demo, which will include two unlocked classes and some items. In the demo, you’ll be able to try both game modes, though you won’t be able to gain tickets.

The next devlog will highlight additional features and provide more information about the game.
